title: Parents Night Out
seo_title: Parents Night Out in Joplin, MO – Dec 11
description: Parents Night Out is a kids' evening at Joplin First Church of the Nazarene where children ages 3-12 enjoy food, games, Christmas crafts, and a movie while parents get a few hours for shopping, wrapping gifts, a date night, or rest. It is free for children ages 3-12, and signing up in advance through the Facebook event or the registration form is requested so the church can prepare; everyone is welcome and church membership is not needed. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 9:00 PM at 2124 Utica St in Joplin, MO.
